 Pelicans vs. Warriors Picks, Predictions, Props & Odds for Monday Night NBA Action
 Michael Sciangula Nov 9, 2026 5:30 PM EST 4 min read 
 Home / Pelicans Vs Warriors Picks Predictions Props Odds 
 The Golden State Warriors have completely turned their season around after a disastrous 0-3 start. Seven consecutive victories now have the Warriors sitting at 7-3, and they’ll look to complete a perfect six-game homestand on Monday night when they host the New Orleans Pelicans at the Chase Center.
 Stephen Curry has unsurprisingly been leading the charge for Golden State, averaging 33.8 points during the team’s ongoing winning streak. The two-time MVP is coming off a 41-point performance against Orlando on Saturday, when he scored 19 points in the fourth quarter and overtime to help the Warriors escape with a victory.
 New Orleans (4-6) has experienced somewhat of an up-and-down start of its own. After losing its first four games, the Pelicans rattled off four straight wins before dropping their last two against Minnesota and the Clippers.
 The Pelicans now face a difficult turnaround after allowing 139 points in Sunday’s loss to the Clippers. They’ll be playing their second game in as many nights against a Golden State team that has been particularly strong on its home floor.
 Pelicans vs. Warriors Odds Today 
 The Warriors are listed as 9.5-point home favorites at Hard Rock Bet Sportsbook as they look to extend their winning streak to eight games:
 Winner : Pelicans (+350), Warriors (-450)
 Spread : Pelicans +9.5 (-110), Warriors -9.5 (-110)
 Total : Over 231.5 (-115), Under 231.5 (-105)
 Pelicans vs. Warriors Best Bet 
 Before placing any bets on tonight’s Western Conference clash, be sure to check out Hard Rock Bet’s Stats Hub for countless trends, streaks and other useful insights to help you shape your betting card. Tonight’s best bet comes from Stats Hub, highlighting a player prop that’s hit in 9 of its last 10 spots:
 Draymond Green Under 5.5 Points (-110): Draymond has scored less than six points in nine of his last 10 games dating back to last season, including each of his last five appearances. His scoring numbers have been especially low as of late, with just two points against Orlando on Saturday after finishing with two against Miami and four against Phoenix. Over his last five games, he’s scored a combined 13 points in total.
 Draymond has never been a player who needs to score to make an impact. His value comes from his passing, defense and ability to create opportunities for his teammates.
 With Draymond consistently looking to pass first, I like our chances of another low-scoring performance from the veteran.
 Best Bet: Draymond Green Under 5.5 Points (-110)
